description: Last login timestamp for user accounts, stored as fixed 19-character strings. Contains 30 records with 0 missing values (100% complete) and 28 distinct values; two values are repeated ('2023-11-17 00:00:00' and '2023-07-10 00:00:00'). All observed values show midnight time (00:00:00) and span from 2019-01-01 to 2024-05-12. Currently stored as string but intended for datetime operations.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert data type from string to datetime64[ns] to enable proper temporal filtering and sorting.
[CLARIFY] Confirm whether the uniform '00:00:00' time component indicates date-only precision (with time defaulting to midnight) or if time-of-day data is missing.

[VALIDATE] Ensure all values follow the format: 4-digit year, hyphen, 2-digit month, hyphen, 2-digit day, space, 2-digit hour, colon, 2-digit minute, colon, 2-digit second — e.g., 2023-03-30 00:00:00.
